mainSection.name: Harsh Singh
mainSection.description: Software Engineer, SaaS Builder, Freelancer, and Educator. I work at a leading product-based MNC and have cracked interviews at top product and service-based companies. My expertise spans software development, system design, cloud architecture, DevOps, and scalable distributed systems. Beyond my day job, I build SaaS products, help businesses bring ideas to life, create technical content, and mentor aspiring developers. I'm passionate about building impactful products, solving complex engineering problems, and sharing knowledge with the tech community.

items.title: Sr. Software Engineer
